data.title: Reminder: 2027 club membership fee (TSV Beispielstadt)
data.summary: TSV Beispielstadt 1898 e.V. sent a reminder dated 21 May 2027 because the direct debit for the 2027 tennis membership fee bounced. €183.00 is outstanding (€180.00 fee plus €3.00 reminder costs), due by 4 June 2027.
data.explanation: Your sports club could not collect the annual fee because your account had insufficient funds when it tried. You now owe the fee plus €3.00 for the bank's returned-debit charge. Transfer €183.00 to the club's account by 4 June 2027. If the money does not arrive by then, your right to play is suspended (ruht) under § 5 of the club's fee rules until you pay. Use your membership number as the reference. If you think the amount is wrong, contact the club's office.

items.title: Pay outstanding membership fee
items.action: Transfer €183.00 (fee €180.00 plus €3.00 reminder costs) to the club's bank account.
items.consequence: Your right to play (Spielrecht) is suspended under § 5 of the fee rules until the amount is paid.
